_comment: Top-of-page prices, fetched from Yahoo via yfinance rather than Alpha Vantage.
Yahoo is unmetered, which is what makes crypto, futures and several international
markets affordable - the Alpha Vantage free tier could not carry them alongside
The 10-year yield and VIX come from Yahoo too, NOT from the regime engine's FRED
data. FRED publishes daily series at T+1, so sourcing them there put two tiles a
full day behind their neighbours on the same strip. FRED remains the source for
the engine's history and scoring, where the lag does not matter and the long,
Order is deliberate: US equities, then bonds, then hard assets, then the world.
